title: skills: teach the fault edge after an approval step and the RESUME_FAILED refusal members (innerRefusal, userMessage)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: the `Skills-docs: follow-up` card owed by PR #34619 (Fixes #34579, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`), passed on by area `o2-H` (L1-c D2 on ACCEPT 6938291867). Dedupe: `RESUME_FAILED innerRefusal skill`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:skills · Blocked-by #34579 (teach the shape only after it lands)

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34579 让审批通过后下一步被记录钩子拒绝时,`RESUME_FAILED` 错误体带上拒绝码与原文(`innerRefusal`)和钩子声明的那句话(`userMessage`);流程作者在这一步画 fault 边，拒绝就走 fault 分支，流程不卡。教 AI 写审批流程的技能还没讲这两点。
- 为什么要修：技能不教,AI 写审批后的「改记录」步骤时不会画 fault 边，被钩子拒绝时流程照样卡住，审批人只看到 500。
- 需要你做的：无(落地时按受管面照常审批)。

## Change

After PR #34619 merges, teach in `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`:

1. Draw a `fault` edge on the step after an approval when that step writes a record a hook may refuse; the refusal then takes the fault branch and the decision returns normally.
2. Without that edge the decision door answers `RESUME_FAILED` (status 500 per the standing ruling), and its body carries `innerRefusal` (code and text) and `userMessage` (the hook's declared end-user sentence) so the approver sees why.

Take the wording from the merged code and approvals docs; do not restate it in a third place. Add one eval that writes an approval flow whose next step updates a record guarded by a refusing hook, and checks the flow draws the `fault` edge.

## Done when

The reference teaches both points and the eval passes.

Blocked-by: #34579
